name: Construction of a system of which a given system is a homomorphic image
description: Exercise 4.71: with SZ2 = {(x, NZ1(x,p))} ∪ {(x,x)}, IZ2 = IZ1, OZ2 = OZ1, NZ2((x,y),p) = (y, NZ1(y,p)) and RZ2 = RZ1 ∘ PJN2, prove that Z1 = HIMSY(Z2, PJN(SZ2,2), ID(IZ2), ID(OZ2)).

elements.text: SZ2 = {(x, NZ1(x,p)) : x ∈ SZ1, p ∈ IZ1} ∪ {(x,x) : x ∈ SZ1}, a subtype of SZ1 × SZ1.
Z2 = (SZ2, IZ1, OZ1, NZ2, RZ2) with NZ2((x,y),p) = (y, NZ1(y,p)) and RZ2 = RZ1 ∘ PJN2.
PJN2 is onto SZ1 (via the diagonal pairs) and intertwines the transitions and readouts.
